facts.fact: A pilot phase in early 2026 trained 583 people from three departments (Industry and Commerce, Digital, Public Service), according to Abdou Diatta at the validation workshop, which also noted a dropout rate at examinations.
facts.system: Plan national de formation des agents de l'Etat (pilot phase)

facts.fact: The Public Service and Telecommunications ministries, with Force N, drew up a national training plan on digital and AI skills for state agents (categories A, B and C), validated at a workshop around 10 September 2026, with a first five-module programme ready to deploy; of 183,500 agents counted, 35,857 are flagged for priority training, and the targets are 70% exam participation, 75% pass rate and at least 80% of agents in one module.
